case_number: Criminal Appeal Nos. 1025-1026 OF 2023 (@ SLP (Crl.) Nos. 12794-12795 OF 2022)
summary: Appeal challenging High Court's quashing of criminal proceedings under Section 482 Cr.P.C; High Court erred by conducting mini-trial; charges need proof only at trial stage, not at quashing stage; court cannot determine malicious prosecution pre-trial; jurisdictional overreach in evaluating evidence prematurely; criminal proceedings restored for trial; 12-month trial deadline imposed due to delayed proceedings since 2014.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashing criminal proceedings set aside; trial to be concluded within 12 months; respondents to face trial; contentions and defenses kept open for trial court.
